literal_meaning: ঘাড় নিচু করে গুঁজে রাখা (neck lowered and buried)
figurative_meaning_en: To bow down or submit humbly
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার ভুলের জন্য ঘাড় গুঁজে ক্ষমা চাইল।
কাজে মনোযোগী হয়ে ঘাড় গুঁজে কাজ করো।
example_sentences_in_english: He bowed his head and apologized for his mistake.
Focus on your work and keep your head down diligently.
note: The idiom reflects traditional Bengali expressions of respect and modesty, often used in rural or semi-urban contexts.
